audience.programmeDescription: Radboud Dentistry combines the science of oral health with dental diagnosis, prevention and treatment. Dental theory and medical foundations lead through preclinical technical training to supervised patient care, alongside research and professional development.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers related biomedical, psychological and communication study. It does not offer the dental knowledge, technical procedures, radiology competencies and supervised clinics that define this degree. We therefore show the Radboud curriculum without presenting a UCR programme as a sufficiently close alternative.

curriculum.limitation: The adopted curriculum comprises 175.5 EC of required study and 4.5 EC of open academic choice. The 10.5 EC research component includes the bachelor thesis. Clinical work has specific preclinical, infection-prevention, radiology and professional-behaviour entry requirements. Active attendance applies to clinical teaching, practicals, workgroups and guest lectures unless stated otherwise. Academic Dutch assessment carries no extra credits. The usual first-year study-advice threshold is 42 EC. The bachelor alone does not qualify a dentist; the subsequent master and applicable professional requirements remain separate.

componentNotes.y2-02: Required academic, professional and personal development, including preparation for research.
componentNotes.y2-09: Compulsory 7-EC clinical patient treatment under dental faculty supervision, beginning in the second semester of year two.
componentNotes.y2-10: Open academic choice worth 4.5 EC. The university and examination board rules determine which courses may be included.
componentNotes.y3-03: The 10.5 EC research component includes a written bachelor thesis, an oral presentation and assessment of the research process. Entry requires an approved research protocol and its presentation.
